description: This file defines the EntityLastInstalledSchemaRepository class, which manages installed entity definitions and field storage definitions in Drupal, including caching and persistence mechanisms.

classes.name: EntityLastInstalledSchemaRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing installed entity and field storage definitions in Drupal, with caching support.

methods.name: getLastInstalledDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the last installed definition for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getLastInstalledDefinitions
methods.description: Returns all installed entity type definitions, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: setLastInstalledDefinition
methods.description: Stores the last installed definition for a given entity type.

methods.name: deleteLastInstalledDefinition
methods.description: Deletes the last installed definition and related field storage definitions for a given entity type.

methods.name: getLastInstalledFieldStorageDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves field storage definitions for a specific entity type, with caching.

methods.name: setLastInstalledFieldStorageDefinitions
methods.description: Sets multiple field storage definitions for an entity type.

methods.name: setLastInstalledFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Adds or updates a single field storage definition for an entity type.

methods.name: deleteLastInstalledFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Removes a specific field storage definition from an entity type.
